title: GLOBAL TECH INDUSTRIES GROUP, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Global Tech Industries Group, Inc. (GTII), a micro-cap company trading on OTC Pink Markets, filed Form 8-K disclosing that Barton CPA PLLC resigned as its independent registered public accounting firm on April 15, 2026. Barton had not issued any audit reports during the engagement period, and no disagreements or reportable events were identified. The company has not yet engaged a replacement auditor. A court-appointed receiver ordered Barton to appear and testify on May 6, 2026, regarding the circumstances of the resignation.
